chapter: Other bands: Royal Jazz, H&J, Rainbow Room
title: Drummer Jules (Jack) Pierre
summary: They talk about Jack Pierre, who drummed at the H&J, may have played with Clayton, and may have sold Russell a banjo.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Did you speak about Jules Pierre at the H&G?
Yes I did. He was a drummer? He was a drummer, yes.
I've heard of him but I don't believe I've ever met him.
Yeah, we call him Jack Pierre. He was impressive. He'd been downtown for all his days, for years. Is he still alive? Yes, he's still alive. You all would like to get and take with him too?
I might have his address. I think he's the one I got a banjo from once. Did he ever play banjo? Or at least he sold a banjo. If he did, I can't remember.
Do you know his address? Did you get his address?
Doesn't matter. Yeah, I can get his address. Did he play with Clayton? Did he play for a while with Clayton?
